meta.hazard: Snapshot. Regenerate only AFTER a matview refresh, re-ingest or position backfill.

popular.ranking: rt of the player's best Modern Era season at one of the clubs; tie-break career honour flags, then card_id
popular.selection: every club to the minimum first (best-ranked first), then the rest by rank up to the cap

battle.goalThreat: percent_rank of radarFor .raw across the deck
battle.reliability: percent_rank of minutes within own league-season (pool = all outfield cards with 900+ minutes), unrounded, then re-ranked across the deck
battle.roleMastery: mean of radarFor .scaled goalThreat, creation, progression, defensive
battle.convention: fraction strictly below x100, rounded (Postgres percent_rank)
